name: Disneyland Carnation Café Famous Loaded Baked Potato Soup (Take Lactase)
brandOrRestaurant: Carnation Café (Main Street, U.S.A. · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Smooth, tender potato chunks simmered in a rich velvety base with cheddar and bacon; low in fiber and soothing on cool evenings when you hold the raw green onion garnish and take lactase.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a cup of the Baked Potato Soup with NO raw green onions/chives on top and take 1–2 lactase enzyme tablets.
watchOuts: Creamy dairy base requires lactase enzymes; ask for no raw green onion garnish
